title: Caving Cadets Homeschool Series (Sequiota Cave Exploration)
seo_title: Caving Cadets Homeschool: Sequiota Cave Exploration
description: Caving Cadets is a homeschool series from Outdoor Initiatives where students explore caves, learn about bats, cave formations and salamanders, and take part in educational games and a cave-specific activity each day. The series visits caves in Lost Hill, Ritter Springs, and Doling Parks, with drop-off at the main parking lot at 11 AM and pickup at 2 PM. This session is Friday, November 20, 2026 at 11:00 AM at Sequiota Park, 3500 S Lone Pine, Springfield, MO; register by the Friday before, and call 417-833-8647 with questions.
